Each gate runs in the toolchain environment (`toolchain.md`) against the built
UFO and the compiled `ttf`, prints its measured value beside its threshold, and
on failure prints a message naming the glyph and what to change in the spec.
A gate the run did not execute is reported as `not run`, never as passed.

The thresholds below are stated defaults (own analysis). The reconstruction
benchmark is what may move them; nothing else does.

## 1. Outline hygiene and coverage

- **Every contour closed.** An open contour fails with the glyph and the point
  index.
- **Counters per glyph** equal an expected table: o 1, e 1, a 1, b d p q 1,
  A 1, D O P Q 1, R 1, B 2, 8 2, 0 1, 4 1 (closed form) or 0 (open form, as the
  spec says), 6 1, 9 1, g 1 or 2 (single- or
  double-storey, as the spec says). A filled or a doubled counter fails.
- **Points at extrema** on every curve, within 1 unit.
- **No contour under the size threshold** — an area below 0.05 % of the em
  square is a stray fragment and fails.
- **Direction correct for the outline format** — outer contours clockwise in
  TrueType (`glyf`) output and counter-clockwise in CFF output, counters wound
  opposite to their outer contour in both.
- **Fill rule declared before overlap removal** — overlap removal runs on a
  glyph only after its fill rule and contour directions are settled; running it
  first is how a counter disappears.
- **Coverage** — every glyph the spec's tier names exists and is non-empty
  (`space` excepted). A missing glyph fails with the tier and the name.

## 2. Vertical metrics

- `OS/2` typo ascender, descender and line gap agree with `hhea` ascender,
  descender and line gap.
- Both line gaps are `0`.
- `USE_TYPO_METRICS` (`OS/2.fsSelection` bit 7) is set.
- `usWinAscent` and `usWinDescent` cover the family's extremes: the highest and
  lowest point of any glyph, diacritics included. A clipped extreme fails with
  the glyph.

## 3. System consistency

- **Stems by ray-cast at half x-height** — a horizontal ray at `x_height / 2`
  across n h m u l i; every vertical stem it crosses is within **3 %** of the
  spec's `lowercase_vertical`. Capitals the same at half cap height across
  H I L E F T against `capital_vertical`.
- **Overshoot** — o O e c s reach **1 to 3 %** beyond baseline and x-height or
  cap height, and within 0.5 % of the spec's `overshoot.round`; pointed apexes
  (A V W v w) within 0.5 % of `overshoot.pointed`.
- **Ink area per glyph group** — the filled share of each glyph's advance box,
  grouped (straight lowercase, round lowercase, capitals, figures), within
  **±12 %** of its group's median. An outlier fails with the glyph.

## 4. Spacing before kerning

- **Sidebearings from edge classes first** — straight, round and diagonal edges
  take the spec's `spacing` values. Set them on H, n, O and o, check `HHOHH`
  and `nnonn` in the proof, and only then propagate to the derived glyphs.
- **Kerning classes from edge groups only afterwards** — a kerning class is an
  edge group, never a single glyph, except for a named exception pair.
- **Collision check** — render the kerning strings (`AVATAR`, `To`, `Ty`, `LT`,
  `P.`, `r,`, `f)` and their German counterparts for `latin-de`) and fail on any
  two glyphs whose outlines intersect.
- **Features built** — `kern`, `mark` (diacritic anchors), `liga` (where the
  spec defines ligatures) and, where figures exist, `tnum`.
- **Shaping confirms the features apply** — shape the kerning strings, an
  accented word and a ligature through the shaping binding and fail when the
  shaped advances or glyph ids equal the unshaped ones.

## 5. Rendered proof

The witness reading, not a gate script: `ui:render --profile asset` over the
proof SVG reads `loaded` for the new family (`SKILL.md` step 7). `error`,
`unloaded`, `timeout` or `synthesised` fails, and so does a reading with no text
in it — the shape an HTML target produces. The agent has looked at the PNG.

## 6. Source fidelity — path A

Applies to path A only. On path B the QA report reads `not applicable` for this
gate, which is neither `not run` nor passed.

The wordmark text set in the new font, aligned to the source by baseline and
cap height, compared by **silhouette IoU** with the method `svg-authoring` uses
for a raster-to-vector conversion (saturated regions, registration recorded as
`x,y,w,h` in the source's pixel frame, scorer and sample resolution named).

- per glyph **≥ 0.90**
- per word **≥ 0.85**
- a **locked signature glyph ≥ 0.95**

Produce the diff overlay (source and render in two colours, overlap neutral) and
look at it. A source flagged `resolution_confidence: low` reports these numbers
but cannot pass this gate.

## 7. Metric-matched fallback

Emit the fallback `@font-face` for the new family over a named local system face,
with `size-adjust`, `ascent-override`, `descent-override` and
`line-gap-override` derived from the built font's own tables — the derivation is
the one in `docs/guidelines/design-asset-discipline.md` (the swapped-face
bullet). That is what catalogue tell T12 asks a swapped webfont to carry.
